sources.title: Cam Heyward blasts "stupid" franchise tag
sources.description: When the NFL and NFL Players Association finalized a landmark Collective Bargaining Agreement in 1993, which resolved the antitrust lawsuit that followed the 1987 strike, the term "franchise tag" entered the pro football lexicon.
